steps.content: A group wielding peculiar weapons bursts through the broken door. You instinctively back away, only to realize they're not after you at all—they're going straight for Korryn.

steps.speaker: Elderly Man
steps.content: Korryn! Thank heavens you're safe!
Young and old, strong and frail—the figures all crowd around Korryn. The room goes into an uproar as some burst into tears and others reprimand her.

steps.speaker: Elderly Man
steps.content: You troublemaker! Do you have any idea how worried we were? Breaking into the Bureau, of all places! Since when did you get so brazen, huh?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Aw, lighten up, Mayor. Worrying makes you age faster.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Just look at Abuela Susan—she's way older than you but looks half your age—ow!
Before Korryn can finish her sentence, she receives a solid whack on the head.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: You little brat! Think you're something special now, do you?!

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Get a kick out of playing hero, eh?! You think we old timers are just dead weight that needs your protection?!

The wrinkled old woman, with dual guns and loaded magazines at her waist, is fiercely indignant. Her palm lands on Korryn's back with resounding smacks... not what you expected of the "weak and elderly" folks of Tuco.
Korryn makes a show of dodging, but there's no real attempt to resist. Despite her stream of protests, she can't keep the smile off her face.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No, no—ow! Of course not, Abuela Susan!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: How could I possibly think that? You've been taking care of me since I was a drooling baby... Ouch, that hurts...!
She presses her palms together and bats her eyes innocently to the crowd around her.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I promise all of you that this will never, ever happen again! Really!
The crowd stirs restlessly, clearly unsatisfied with Korryn's half-hearted apology. The mayor pushes through the crowd and raises his voice.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Alright, alright, everyone calm down!

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: We've found who we came for. Now let's tidy up and head back!
After speaking, he turns to look at you with confusion, as if trying to figure out who you are.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Ahem, allow me to introduce—the one and only, Chief of the MBCC! This is the superhero that little Hella can't stop talking about, ${PlayerName}!
The man stares at you in disbelief for a moment before turning to Korryn. After she responds with an emphatic nod, the Mayor explodes.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Korryn!! What kind of trouble have you gotten yourself into now?!!!

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Oh good heavens... I don't know what this troublemaker did this time, but it must be all her fault! Please rest assured, we promise to discipline her when we get back! We won't let her out to cause any more trouble!

options: She snuck into the MBCC without your knowledge.

choices.text: She snuck into the MBCC without your knowledge.

steps.content: No better time than now to spill the beans. As you list out Korryn's misdeeds, the mayor's face grows darker with each detail. By the end, he's too stunned to even be angry. After shooting Korryn a fierce glare, he turns to you apologetically.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: What nonsense about Hella! **** sake, that girl left with the Legion ages ago! Don't listen to Korryn's ridiculous stories!

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Ahem, if you don't mind, you're welcome to travel with us. We'll make it our priority to escort you back to your companions. Consider it our way of making amends for Korryn's reckless behavior!

options: You're planning to cross through the sandstorm?

choices.text: You're planning to cross through the sandstorm?

steps.content: The sandstorm hasn't subsided yet. You're planning to cross through it?

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Heh, you needn't worry about that.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: —Wow, where'd you get this sand ship? Is it a new model?
You hear Korryn's voice from outside, eagerly appraising her newest object of fascination.

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Borrowed it from a kind soul on the way. Pretty sweet ride, eh?

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: And this baby ain't our only prize. Look what else we've got—

As you approach the door, you spot a small sand ship that's nearly crashed into the entrance, and a middle-aged man with a smug grin. He furtively pulls back the seat, revealing an eerie blue glow that illuminates his face.
Your eyes meet the Mayor's once more, and he gives you a knowing smile.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Don't worry, we have our own ways of dealing with danger—they might seem unconventional, but sometimes old tricks work best.
[Black Screen]
It's true that the Tuco folks are mostly children, the sick and the elderly... but can truly helpless people survive this long in WhiteSands?
You quickly realize you've underestimated them.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen, we're expecting some turbulence ahead. Please fasten your seatbelts and hold on tight—
Scorching winds whip against your face as the sand ship plows through the storm, breaking free into safety at last.

As the yellow sands dissipate, the surrounding landscape gradually comes into focus. The passengers look visibly queasy from the rough ride... all except Korryn, who stands at the bow with a broad grin, clearly amused by everyone else's distress.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: You can always count on my flawless driving!

steps.speaker: Abuela Susan
steps.content: You rascal, drive properly for heaven's sake!

steps.speaker: Abuela Susan
steps.content: After all this time with the Chief, you haven't picked up any manners at all! Look how polite the Chief is—even thanking me just now!
Amidst the commotion, you recall the battle in the sandstorm between the Tuco folks and the sand beasts. Working in perfect unison, they swiftly defeated the monsters without needing your help.
This mysterious sand ship, those exceptional driving skills, and the strange weapons and fighting techniques...
Korryn suddenly appears beside you, draping her arm across your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: How about that? Pretty awesome, eh? You'd never see views like this on those big DisCity ships—
Wind-swept sand streams toward the horizon like flowing amber clouds, before dispersing to unveil the blazing sun behind.
She's right—only in WhiteSands can you witness sunlight this pure and unfiltered.
But...
Pardon me, but I'd like to clarify something.
You take another careful look at your surroundings.
—Weren't you supposed to take me to rejoin my MBCC squad first? Why does it seem like we're getting further and further away from DisCity?
The arm around your shoulders freezes for a moment. The Tuco folks burst out laughing nearby.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: Oh my! I did say that, didn't I? What an excellent memory you have!

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: I'm not as sharp as you. I'm an old man, and I forget many things. Speaking of which, there's another thing I forgot to mention!
The Mayor's face breaks into that same mischievous grin you've seen so often on Korryn as he presents you with a contract.

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: It was no small trouble giving you a ride. After we get a small compensation for our services, we can be on our way.
You turn to Korryn, who is already watching you. When your eyes meet, she flashes you an innocent smile.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't look at me like that, Chief. I may be fond of you, but I'm still one of them, you know.
Clearly no help will be coming from her. You reach for the contract. They're the hunters and you're the prey, so your options are limited.

"I, ${PlayerName}, Chief of the MBCC, hereby commit in my personal capacity to provide charitable donations to all residents of Tuco, including quarterly provisions of living supplies and additional emergency aid when requested..."

steps.speaker: Mayor
steps.content: It'll just be a small amount of DisCoins and Hypercubes each time—at official rates. That's all we ask. Nothing unreasonable.
"In addition, provide basic welfare to Tuco..." Wait, why is there a separate clause about sand ship repairs?

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Oh, that! The big ship's such a pain to fix, and we can't keep going to the fortress to borrow a new one every time it breaks down—
WHACK! Abuela Susan smacks Wright's head with her cane and drags him away.
Korryn shrugs, pretending she hasn't heard a thing.
...Okay.
Now, how much would I be donating... Huh?
You're surprised at the figure. Unlike Korryn's extortionate demands, the Mayor's contract asks for a surprisingly modest sum.
Based on what you know about Tuco's population, this is the bare minimum they need for survival.

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Do you think the amount is too little, Chief?
The middle-aged man who was dragged away can't help but interject.

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Sigh, I think it's too little too! How's this gonna be enough? We've got a golden goose right here—why are we just letting it go just like that?

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: But our Mayor doesn't see it that way! He says "the Chief's a virtual saint who's brain-meltingly, earth-shatteringly, heart-breakingly nice! We can't take advantage of someone like that too much!"
The man spouts one bizarre term after another like a broken faucet, making your head spin.
It's an offer I can't refuse.
The Tuco folks burst into excited cheers—they'd probably toss you in the air if circumstances allowed. You find Korryn in the crowd and continue speaking.
Besides this, I have another proposition I'd like to discuss with you.

In addition to our previous donation, the MBCC will give you resources regularly. You're free to keep them or share them with others who need Hypercubes—I won't ask any questions about how you distribute them.
You meet Korryn's gaze. She seems to guess what you're about to say, and her expression shifts to surprise.
But in return... I want you to be my eyes in this region.
Thanks to Korryn's warm hospitality, I've had the chance to return to WhiteSands and see its people for who they truly are, as well as witness the changes taking place here.
So, after I leave, I hope someone will keep watch over WhiteSands on my behalf. If you see or hear anything unusual, contact the MBCC immediately. We'll provide fair compensation for any information.
When you finish speaking, the ship falls silent for a few seconds before erupting into laughter. Korryn doubles over, tears of laughter oozing from her eyes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Pfft, hahahahaha...! And here I thought you were going to say something else, hahahahaha!

steps.speaker: Abuela Susan
steps.content: Well, well! This young man has such big ambitions—Korryn, you've brought us quite a handful!
steps.female_content: Well, well! This young lady has such big ambitions—Korryn, you've brought us quite a handful!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yeah, quite a handful indeed, but awesome enough to be worth it...
Korryn wipes the tears from her eyes and gives you a hearty pat on the back.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't worry, sweetie. From today on, you're not just my friend—you're Tuco's friend...
Korryn grabs the wheel and slams down on the accelerator.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Time to take our good friend home!
[Black Screen]
True to their word, the Tuco folks quickly return you to the MBCC squad's camp.
As you leave the sand boat, the crowd surrounds you with hugs, refusing to let go until Korryn finally comes to shoo them away.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Well then, my dear Chief. You're home now. I should get going.
She leans against the sand boat and tosses you another piece of candy.
Is this the ten-days-expired kind?
Korryn gives you a sly wink.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: No, this one expired today.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Sorry about using little Hella to lure you out, and for making you sign such a ruthless contract. How about this—take me back to the MBCC, give me a title, and I'll do whatever you want. As long as the pay is good—

options: Alright, that's enough out of you.

choices.text: Alright, that's enough out of you.

steps.content: My offer wasn't just for you—it was for everyone in Tuco.
If you try to keep it all for yourself, that abuela will knock some sense into you, no?
The bounty hunter shakes her head with a smile, brushing the sand off your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Yeah, that won't happen again.
After dusting off the sand and smoothing out your clothes, Korryn gives your pocket a casual pat.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Alright, time to say goodbye for real. I left you a little gift—take a look when you get back.
A gift? When did you slip that in?
Korryn responds with a wink before boarding Tuco's sand boat. The vessel roars to life and vanishes amidst a cloud of dust.
You feel your pocket and pull out an envelope. In the distance, task force agents spot you and hurry over.

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: Chief! Something terrible has happened!
They rush forward urgently, their faces full of anxiety and guilt.

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: Our Hypercubes have been stolen! Everything in storage is gone—they took everything except the few pieces our squad members had on them!

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: It must have been those guides... they claimed to be a local rescue team from WhiteSands that helps people caught in sandstorms. They were the only ones who saw us handling the Hypercubes, but... we were with them the whole time! They shouldn't have had any chance to steal them...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: —Wow, Wright! Where'd you get this sand ship? Is it a new model?

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: Borrowed it from a kind soul on the way. Pretty sweet ride, eh?

steps.speaker: Wright
steps.content: And this baby ain't our only prize. Look what else we've got—
You spin around, but Tuco's sand boat is already speeding away, becoming nothing but a speck in the horizon.
The restless hot wind carries fragments of distant voices to your ears—Hurry up! Move it!

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: Ch-Chief? What are you looking at?
You look down at the opened letter in your hand.
The messy handwriting gleefully details how Korryn played Hella for a fool, tricking her over and over again till she had nothing left.
Just made a deal—jury's still out on whether it was worth it. Let's head back to DisCity.
Korryn leans against the boat, observing the frantic task force agents in the distance, as well as the composed grey figure who stands among them.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: How can you hire WhiteSands' finest bounty hunter with such a measly sum?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Silly Chief... too kind and soft-hearted for your own good.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Don't worry, I'll handle what you can't. I'll be your eyes in WhiteSands and keep track of everything that happens here. And maybe you'll find ways to change the things I can't...
This is a unique arrangement, neither purely transactional nor based in friendship. Each has become an extension of the other's sight, illuminating paths the other cannot see.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Let's see what you can really do.
